AI link, threading: no race today. FogSightState is a function-local static written only by EngineGL33::UpdateFogMedium (EngineGL33_PostFog.cpp 324, called from the lighting upload at EngineGL33_Lighting.cpp 1040) and by DestroyFogResources (380). It is read only by EntityAI::CalcVisibility (from Target.cpp 852, InGameUI.cpp 1918 and InGameUIDraw.cpp 947), all on the main thread. The terrain map is built on worker threads but handed over through a std::future polled on the main thread (TerrainLighting.cpp 343-353), and it is immutable afterwards. TaskPool only runs landscape segment fill and audio decode. The static would become a race only if AI sensing moved onto workers.

AI link, multiplayer and consistency risk (real): AI sight follows the LOCAL renderer state. Only EngineGL33 calls SetFogSight, so a dedicated server or headless process keeps the link off: server-owned AI ignores mist while client-local AI (a player's squad) is dimmed by that client's fog. The link also turns off whenever this frame's fog is not applied: post effects off, SSAA path off, fog unavailable, or a vehicle interior view (_prevWorldDepthCleared, EngineGL33_PostFog.cpp 305). So in single player the AI sees through mist while the player sits in a tank interior view. The tuning knobs fogDensity and fogMist also scale the AI terms. Suggested root fix, keeping the link: compute the AI medium in the simulation from weather and time (ComputeFogMedium with applied=true) and build the sight map at island load, independent of the render path.
